proposals.title: Proposal 5: Report on Global Median Gender Pay Gap
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender pay gap, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, operational risks and risks of recruiting and retaining female talent.
proposals.evidence: Accordingly, our Board recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal (Proposal 5).

proposals.title: Proposal 6: Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, consistent with applicable law.
proposals.evidence: Accordingly, our Board recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal (Proposal 6).

proposals.title: Proposal 7: Enhance Shareholder Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending proxy access bylaws so proxy access candidates need not obtain a specific percentage vote to qualify for future nomination.
proposals.evidence: Accordingly, our Board recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal (Proposal 7).
